style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">这份资源清单是专门为新手挑选的。我按照</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">学习顺序</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">和</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">难易程度</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">进行了分类，重点推荐了中文社区最优质的教程（特别是李文周的博客，被称为 Go 语言新手的“圣经”）。</span></p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><br></p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 16pt; font-weight: bold">1. HTTP 与网络基础 (必看理论)</p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">在写代码前，你需要先搞懂“浏览器和服务器是怎么对话的”。</p></div><ul class="list-0" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; font-weight: bold">MDN HTTP 概述 (权威文档)</span><ul class="list-1" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><a href="https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fdeveloper.mozilla.org%2Fzh-CN%2Fdocs%2FWeb%2FHTTP%2FOverview" style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">MDN Web Docs - HTTP</a></span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">推荐理由</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">：Mozilla 的官方文档，全球公认最权威的前端/Web文档，内容非常详细。</span></span></li>
</ul></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; font-weight: bold">图解 HTTP (通俗易懂)</span><ul class="list-2" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><a href="https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ruanyifeng.com%2Fblog%2F2016%2F08%2Fhttp.html" style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">阮一峰：HTTP 协议入门</a></span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">推荐理由</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">：阮一峰老师的文章深入浅出，适合初学者快速理解概念。</span></span></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><br></p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 16pt; font-weight: bold">2. Go 语言原生 Web 开发 (net/http)</p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">不要跳过这一步直接学 Gin，理解原生库才能看懂框架在做什么。</p></div><ul class="list-3" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; font-weight: bold">Go Web 编程 (开源书)</span><ul class="list-4" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><a href="https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fastaxie%2Fbuild-web-application-with-golang%2Fblob%2Fmaster%2Fzh%2F03.0.md" style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">Build Web Application with Golang - HTTP 基础</a></span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">推荐理由</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">：Go 语言早期的经典开源书籍，第3章专门讲 HTTP 和 Go 的原生实现，非常经典。</span></span></li>
</ul></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; font-weight: bold">Go By Example (代码示例)</span><ul class="list-5" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><a href="https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fgobyexample-cn.github.io%2Fhttp-servers" style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">HTTP Servers (服务端)</a></span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><a href="https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fgobyexample-cn.github.io%2Fhttp-clients" style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">HTTP Clients (客户端)</a></span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">推荐理由</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">：没有废话，直接给你看代码怎么写，适合复制粘贴运行体验。</span></span></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><br></p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 16pt; font-weight: bold">3. Gin 框架 (核心重点)</p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">这是你目前最需要掌握的工具。</p></div><ul class="list-6" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">李文周 (Q1mi) 的 Gin 框架教程 (</span><span style="font-family: Segoe UI Emoji,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">⭐</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold"> 强烈推荐)</span></span><ul class="list-7" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><a href="https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.liwenzhou.com%2Fposts%2FGo%2FGin_framework%2F" style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">Gin框架介绍及使用</a></span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">推荐理由</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">：这是目前国内写得最好的 Go Web 入门系列。</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">请把他的 Gin 系列文章从头读到尾</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">，你的作业基本都能在这里找到答案。</span></span></li>
</ul></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; font-weight: bold">Gin 官方文档</span><ul class="list-8" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><a href="https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fgin-gonic.com%2Fzh-cn%2Fdocs%2F" style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">Gin Web Framework</a></span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">推荐理由</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">：Gin 的中文文档不仅翻译得好，而且有很多现成的例子（比如怎么上传文件、怎么分组路由），适合当字典查。</span></span></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><br></p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 16pt; font-weight: bold">4. 身份校验 (Cookie/Session/JWT)</p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">理解如何给用户“发身份证”。</p></div><ul class="list-9" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; font-weight: bold">JWT 官网 (调试工具)</span><ul class="list-10" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><a href="https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fjwt.io%2F" style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">jwt.io</a></span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">推荐理由</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">：这不仅是文档，还是一个调试器。你可以把生成的 Token 粘贴进去，看看里面到底存了什么数据，非常直观。</span></span></li>
</ul></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; font-weight: bold">Go 语言中使用 JWT (实战)</span><ul class="list-11" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><a href="https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.liwenzhou.com%2Fposts%2FGo%2Fjwt_in_gin%2F" style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">在 Gin 中使用 JWT (李文周)</a></span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">推荐理由</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">：手把手教你如何安装 jwt-go 库，如何生成 Token，以及如何写中间件解析 Token。</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">Lv3 的作业直接参考这篇。</span></span></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><br></p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 16pt; font-weight: bold">5. Hertz 框架 (字节跳动)</p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">学完 Gin 后，看这个会非常快。</p></div><ul class="list-12" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; font-weight: bold">CloudWeGo 官方文档</span><ul class="list-13" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><a href="https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cloudwego.io%2Fzh%2Fdocs%2Fhertz%2Foverview%2F" style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">Hertz 概览</a></span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">推荐理由</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">：官方文档写得很清楚，特别是如果你将来想进字节跳动或者使用微服务，这个框架是必学的。</span></span></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><br></p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 16pt; font-weight: bold">6. 项目结构与分层 (工程化)</p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">如何摆放你的代码文件（Model-Dao-Api）。</p></div><ul class="list-14" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; font-weight: bold">Go 项目分层结构设计</span><ul class="list-15" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><a href="https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fsilverwind%2Fgo-project-layout%2Fblob%2Fmaster%2FREADME_zh-CN.md" style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">Go Web 项目结构 (参考)</a></span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; font-style: italic">(注：初学者不要追求太复杂的 DDD 架构，只需看简单的分层即可)</span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">简单理解</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">：可以参考 </span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">"CLD 分层"</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif"> (Controller/Api -> Logic/Service -> Dao) 的相关文章。</span></span></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><br></p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Segoe UI Emoji,sans-serif; font-size: 16pt; font-weight: bold">💡</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 16pt; font-weight: bold"> 视频教程推荐 (Bilibili)</span></p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">如果你更喜欢看视频操作：</p></div><ol class="list-16" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">七米 (李文周)</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">：B站搜索“七米”，他的 Gin 框架视频教程和他的博客一样优秀。</span></span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">极客兔兔 (Geektutu)</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">：搜索“7天用Go动手写/从零实现Web框架”，这个系列会带你从零造一个 Gin 框架，能让你彻底理解框架内部原理（适合 LvX 进阶）。</span></span></li>
</ol>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Segoe UI Emoji,sans-serif; font-size: 16pt; font-weight: bold">🚀</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-size: 16pt; font-weight: bold"> 学习路线建议</span></p></div><ol class="list-17" style="position: relative"><li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">先看 </span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">Go By Example</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif"> 把 net/http 的 Hello World 跑通。</span></span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">重点攻读 </span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">李文周的 Gin 教程</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">，完成作业的 Lv0 - Lv2。</span></span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">去 </span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">jwt.io</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif"> 玩一下 Token，然后照着 </span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">李文周的 JWT 教程</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif"> 完成 Lv3 - Lv4。</span></span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">最后看 </span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; font-weight: bold">Go Web 编程</span><span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif"> 补充理论细节。</span></span></li>
<li class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><span style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt"><a href="https://www.liwenzhou.com/" style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">李文周的博客 | 总结Go语言学习之路，提供免费的Go语言学习教程，希望与大家一起学习进步。</a></span></li>
